name: three-dev
description: Official three.dev plugin, by round3. Adds three.dev to a codebase so its LLM calls are recorded, then investigates the failure modes three.dev finds in that traffic and proposes a fix, through the three.dev MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Official three.dev plugin, by round3. The three-dev-setup skill routes OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Bedrock, LiteLLM, Vercel AI SDK and LangChain calls through the three.dev proxy, with use cases, sessions and tags. The three-dev-failure-modes skill reads the failure modes three.dev finds in recorded traffic, opens the conversations behind them and proposes a prompt, model, tool or code fix. The three.dev MCP server connects your agent to three.dev.
defaultPrompt: What are the worst failure modes in my LLM feature this week?
Why is my LLM feature failing in production?
